review_description: Salesmanship/quote process all goodHad rain the first day so installers had to return the following day to put the panels on.....otherwise all okCustomer service with their Admin office was good....they had already advised us on what would happen afterwards b4 install & on the day....our electricity provider (Powershop) were very helpful & on the ball

Panels installed on an east-north-east roof with approx. 23 degree slope.  System generates power from sunrise to early afternoon (my household's peak electricity usage time) negating the need for a costly battery.  System generates approx. 10 kws @ winter solace rising to 25 kws @ summer solace.  Have recently had installed a solar diverter to a storage hot water system, thereby sending excess solar to heat hot water prior to exporting to the grid.  Entire system equates to no electricity bill for approx. 6 months per year (excess electricity exported to the grid also covers supply charges for same period).  Bills for balance of the year are < $100/quarter.  Installing the solar system & diverter are proving highly cost effective with payoff projected by 5th year.Note I also have a pre-exisitng (previous house owner installed) 1 kw system of west roof installed by Pyramid Power, which is good for offsetting late spring through to mid autumn afternoon electricity usage, but this system delivers negligble electricity in winter.

Will also have LG chem resu 10 installed. Pyramid Power is one of the best installers on the Far South coast of NSW. Originally had 1.5kw system installed and now FIT has finished am upgrading. Pyramid use only top quality panels and equipment. You get what you pay for.

Have spent 3 years to search for a supplier/installer to give us the right answers for our location in rural NSW. It only took 4 weeks from first contact to a complete and immaculate installation with these folks. Terrific performance!

It is hard to assess the quality of the the system when you have no prior experience with solar, but the system seems to be working well.  The customer service and installation were all very good.  Everything was completed in accordance with the quote, and on time.  The staff are always available if you have questions.
Local firm with long history - Pyramid Power

We chose Pyramid because they have installed quite a few systems in the area around us at Bombala/ Bibbenluke. For a 2.2 kw they are charging us $$6,471.90. Because of our isolation, and because Pyramid have a good name for service around here we chose them.We expect installation before mid June - should you send this form after that I will be happy to respond.
All companies that contacted us were very helpful, even to the point of showing us the cheapest rates for power and the best returns for our solar excess.All round a great experience.
Pyramid were very helpful and gave choices of different systems.

Pyramid Power has yet to install the system but I have been kept informed at every step along the way with a succession of leaflets on 'what happens next' . Delivery is to be made on-site Monday 30th May, with Installation Wednesday 1st June, metering scheduled for Thursday 2nd June.  My experience in talking with would-be contractors was disappointing in that a number failed to provide information sought or it was received very late.  I recomend that anyone considering a Solar system search information the media and internet for say 6 months as a minimum, you can get a wealth of information this way before you start talking to any contractors in your locality, my problem has been that I have had to look away from my country area.

I install  225W Schot poly panels , hooked up to GT5 Xantrax 2.8KW Inverter. I have NWW elevation and so far it was cloudy, hazy and not much sun all together. System gone up on the 06/05 and so far it produced 126KW/h in 1 month. It was installed apx.4 wk early then the initial date. All up and going. including network feed in (and net meeter going)  in one day.Very happy!!!!!!!!
We had installed a solar hotwater system on the house roof and a 3KW grid connect system on the garage. German panels.

As you stated there are a lot of suppliers out there with a lot of information and systems.  What you supplied helped immensely to sort a few of these out.  I wanted to go with someone local as well as reliable, luckily I had a neighbor who was able to help and give additional advice.  Thank you for all of your help.

The hands-off approach by relying on satalite images doesn't lend itself to confidence in the provider. Also the packages are too obscure and on installation could be different to the quotation.  You would by a car from a deal if you were advised to that the car could come with this or that engine depending on the volume available.All I can suggest is for purchases to question, question and question, then set your own specification to obtain your solution.  You will soon eliminate the fly-by-nighters.Cheers
